instructions_to_main_agent.css_additions: Add a global @keyframes shimmer { 100% { transform: translateX(100%); } } to your index.css to support the shimmer animations.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Import 'Outfit' (weights 400, 600) and 'JetBrains Mono' (weights 400, 500) from Google Fonts in index.html.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='sign-in-btn').
instructions_to_main_agent.glassmorphism_rule: Do not use generic gray backgrounds. All cards must be frosted glass over the #050607 background.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Setup react-router for '/' (Landing) and '/dashboard' (Dashboard protected view).
